name: Fermata Auto
author: AndreyPavlenko
description: The ultimate media player for Android Auto. Plays local audio and video files, supports YouTube streaming, IPTV playlists (m3u/m3u8), and includes a built-in web browser with media detection.

defaultVersions.changelog: Added Android 14/15/16 support, performance improvements, and updated media playback engine.
Stability fixes and updated YouTube parser.
Subtitles rendering improvements and IPTV buffering fixes.

name: CarStream
author: theiostream
description: Stream YouTube videos directly onto your vehicle's car screen display. Supports full playback controls, search, account login, and desktop mode.

defaultVersions.changelog: Updated webview compatibility and navigation bar fixes.
Search suggestions and keyboard rendering updates.

name: Screen2Auto
author: Inceptive (annexhack)
description: Advanced screen mirroring for Android Auto. Mirrors your entire smartphone screen to your car dashboard with full multi-touch support, custom DPI adjustments, and app launch shortcuts.

defaultVersions.changelog: Enhanced touch latency and aspect ratio compensation.

name: AA Mirror Plus
author: Rikj000 & slashmax
description: Fork of AA Mirror with expanded features: multi-touch gesture support, automatic screen rotation, custom aspect ratio fitting, and brightness dimming during mirroring.

defaultVersions.changelog: Added support for Android 13+ and high-resolution vehicle displays.

name: AA Passenger
author: Martin Soucha
description: Allows passengers to stream and control music, videos, and navigation cues onto the car's Android Auto screen without touching the driver's phone.

defaultVersions.changelog: Bug fixes for audio stream sync and wireless connection stability.

name: Fermata Control
author: AndreyPavlenko
description: Companion media control app for Fermata Auto. Provides media session notifications, steering wheel key interception, and lockscreen integration.

name: AA Browser
author: FCaronte
description: A full-featured Chromium-based web browser optimized for Android Auto touchscreens. Browse any website, watch HTML5 video, save bookmarks, and navigate with desktop zoom.

defaultVersions.changelog: Tab management, custom user agent toggling, and fast loading.

name: IPcarTV
author: IPcarTV Team
description: Stream live DVB-T and IPTV channels inside Android Auto. Add your favorite m3u8 playlists, view EPG program guides, and switch channels directly using your car screen.

defaultVersions.changelog: Low-latency streaming mode and HLS video decoding.
